name: Brian Misocho Morang’a
title: Senior Backend Engineer — AI Systems & Distributed Systems
summary: Senior backend engineer with 7 years of experience building software across AI-enabled products, healthcare technology, sports performance analytics, and business operations. Experienced in Python backend development, API design, asynchronous processing, data pipelines, and cloud-native systems. Combines practical software engineering with AI integration, emphasizing validated data, explicit business logic, system reliability, and maintainable architectures.

roles.title: Part-Time Backend Engineering Consultant
roles.intro: An AI-powered procurement and operations platform connecting existing business systems, operational data, supplier communications, and documents.
bullets: Part of the team that took the platform from idea to a beta with testing customers in about three months.
Design and build backend services and APIs with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker, plus data models for procurement, suppliers, purchase orders, invoices, and operational exceptions.
Implemented strict validation and normalization for imported operational data, with LLM-assisted extraction behind deterministic business rules.
Added human approval workflows and auditing for consequential actions, and automated coverage for import correctness and idempotent processing.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.intro: Software engineering across backend services, APIs, and asynchronous processing for AI-enabled applications.
bullets: Developed and maintained backend services and REST APIs for AI-enabled applications.
Built asynchronous processing pipelines and service integrations that move work off the request-response path.
Kept business rules explicit alongside AI capabilities, and supported maintainability and code quality.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.intro: Backend engineering for a coach- and athlete-facing performance platform processing training and monitoring data, as part of a wider engineering team.
bullets: Developed and maintained backend services and application APIs for a coach- and athlete-facing performance platform.
Built asynchronous pipelines processing time-series performance data used by analytics.
Led a Rust rewrite of the per-athlete readiness recomputation, cutting processing time from seconds to milliseconds.
Integrated AI-enabled analytics into existing workflows.

roles.title: Backend Lead
roles.intro: Backend systems for an AI-enabled perioperative-care platform supporting time-sensitive operating-room workflows.
bullets: Led backend engineering for an AI-enabled perioperative-care platform within a small team of backend, hardware and junior engineers.
Owned the backend services and APIs (including multi-tenancy), NLP and AI-enabled workflow orchestration, data processing and surgery-document ingestion, and deployments.
Worked with Docker and AWS infrastructure to support deployment and operation, and contributed to the front-end web app and a Raspberry Pi device when needed.

Contributed to product and workflow improvements associated with approximately 15 minutes less surgical turnover per procedure — an internal estimate across partner hospitals over about a year (a team- and product-level outcome, not attributed to one person).

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.intro: Software development for a livestock-management platform serving farmers and related business operations.
bullets: Developed backend functionality with Django and related web technologies.
Built and maintained REST APIs, data models, and business logic for livestock-management workflows.
Contributed marketplace and financial and operational features across backend and frontend components.

roles.title: Software Engineering Intern
roles.intro: Foundational experience in web application engineering, backend development, and collaborative delivery.
bullets: Built web application features using Python, Django, and React.
Contributed to API development and dashboard and reporting interfaces in an aid-distribution context.
Worked within a collaborative, source-controlled, and tested engineering workflow.
